e: Confederation of Christian Trade Unions and General Labour Federation of Belgium stage national demonstration in Brussels to protest the government's budget plans.
Asylum application of Fouad Belkacem, former leader of the jihadist group Sharia4Belgium, rejected.
A large wildfire breaks out in the High Fens, destroying a third of the nature reserve's area.
A hoard of gold bars and coins worth nine million euros is found bricked into a cellar wall during the demolition of a former brewery in Sint-Gillis-bij-Dendermonde.
Six people die and many others are hurt in a fire that broke out in a ten-storey block of flats in Antwerp.
Emperor Naruhito and Empress Masako of Japan arrive in Belgium on a state visit.
Buggenhout train collision with a school bus that ran a level crossing, killing four people and injuring five.
The 2026 Liège–Bastogne–Liège cycle race is won by Tadej Pogačar.

A court in Brussels orders former diplomat Étienne Davignon to stand trial on charges of participation in war crimes in connection with the 1961 killing of former Congolese prime minister Patrice Lumumba. Davignon is the only surviving individual among those accused by Lumumba’s family of involvement in the case.

A synagogue in Liège is damaged in a suspected antisemitic attack involving explosives, claimed by a previously unknown group apparently aligning itself with Hezbollah. A Belgian counter-terrorism official later stated that the attack was directly related to calls from Iran.
Belgian special forces, with French naval assistance, seize a Russian shadow fleet oil tanker in the North Sea.
The foreign ministry summons US ambassador Bill White over a social media post accusing Belgian authorities of antisemitism over an investigation into unregulated ritual circumcisions in Antwerp.
A coalition agreement is reached for the Brussels regional government after a record 20 months of negotiations since the 2024 Belgian regional elections.
Police raid the headquarters of the European Commission in Brussels as part of an investigation into the sale of 23 properties to the Belgian state valued at 900 million euros in 2024.
Two people are killed in a fire at an assisted living facility in Ostend.
